offline.incompleteWarning: Offline files are incomplete ({done}/{total}). The game may not load until the download finishes.
offline.multiplayerDisabled: Multiplayer is not available in offline mode!

clear.hint: Removes the downloaded game files. Saved games and settings stay on this device.
clear.confirmBody: This removes the downloaded game files and the service worker. Saved games, settings, and other game data stay on this device. The game downloads the cache again the next time it loads while online.
clear.confirmOfflineWarning: You are offline. Clearing the cache makes the game unavailable offline until the next visit with a connection.
clear.clearedBody: Cached size is now {size}. The game will download the offline cache again the next time it loads while online.
clear.clearedOfflineWarning: You are offline. Reloading now leaves the game unavailable until the next visit with a connection.

benchmark.label: Performance benchmark
benchmark.heavyFailed: Heavy battle failed. Check the console for details.

gamepad.intro: Each person keeps a player profile. A controller type only fills controls that have no standard button or stick. Player 1 moves the cursor. Player 2 can drive a second unit of the same side.
gamepad.bindHint: A standard button or stick is saved on the player profile. A control with no standard equivalent is saved on the controller type.
gamepad.playerHint: This layout follows the person onto whichever controller is in this slot.
gamepad.typeHint: Used when this controller has a physical control with no standard button or stick.
gamepad.deviceHint: Stored on this controller. Used when the player profile and the controller type leave a command unset.
gamepad.pressAny: Press any button on the controller. Browsers hide a gamepad until a button is pressed.
gamepad.nonStandard: This browser did not report a standard mapping. Bind the raw buttons and axes listed here.
gamepad.ignored: Only two controllers can be used. Extra controllers are ignored.
gamepad.listening: Press a button or move a stick. Escape cancels.
gamepad.deadzoneHint: Motion inside the deadzone is ignored so a resting stick does not jitter.
gamepad.suggestBody: This controller looks like {type}. The {type} layout is selected. Your player profile is unchanged.
gamepad.scrollSpeedHint: How fast the right stick and the cursor edge drag the map. This does not change keyboard or mouse scrolling.
gamepad.defaultsHint: Reset restores this layout. Press the left trigger to drive the selected units with the left stick and turn the turret with the right stick. Press it again to return to the cursor and the map. The mode ends when those units are gone. The D-pad drives without that mode. B / Circle cancels repair, sell, or placement, and otherwise right-clicks.

renderer.unavailable: Using WebGL. WebGPU is not available in this browser.
renderer.didNotInitialize: WebGPU did not initialize. Using WebGL.

multiplayer.joinInvalid: Enter a valid invite code or link.
multiplayer.joinNotFound: That invite code was not found or has expired.
